title: 初一短文：运动日服务台
audio_introduction: Listen and choose the best answer.
instruction: 听一篇完整短文，完成全部5题，每题A/B/C三选。每材料听两遍。源未印精确读答停顿；本机每题前后各5秒，只作审阅编排，可重播。
source_notice: 初一公开月考说明中的完整题面、参考键和印出脚本已核，说明首行标合肥三十中/七上十月月考；原校施测及原版页面身份未独立认证。原音轨未取得，标题含音频不等于已取得。两遍有明文，精确读答时间未印；原参考键不是gold，原创录音不补成原源音频或学生标定。
timing_notice: 源未印精确读答停顿；本机每题前后各5秒，只作审阅编排，可重播。

turns.speaker: N
turns.text: Hello, everyone. I am Rosa. This Saturday is our school sports day. My friends and I will work at a help desk near the main gate. Please come there if you lose something. We will put lost clothes in a blue box and other things in a green box. Write your name and class on a card before you take anything home. The desk opens at eight in the morning and closes at four in the afternoon. You do not need to pay. If you find a watch or a phone, please give it to our teacher, Mr Lee. He will keep these things in his office.

questions.stem: Where will the help desk be?
questions.rationale: A：明确main gate；B：没说泳池；C：没说图书馆

questions.stem: Which box is for lost clothes?
questions.rationale: A：没说红盒；B：绿盒放其他东西；C：蓝盒放衣服

questions.stem: What should students write on a card?
questions.rationale: A：未要电话；B：明确name and class；C：未要家庭地址
A：八点是开放时间；B：未说中午关闭；C：明确下午四点关闭
A：老师李先生放办公室；B：没有姐姐；C：没有厨师
